technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum with extreme overbought readings and exceptional volume spike, but weak trend strength and extended RSI levels present significant pullback risk; suitable for cautious swing entry with tight stops.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (335 reading is data anomaly but indicates severe market stress), flat yield curve with recession risk, FOMC event just passed, and 90-day earnings window create highly unfavourable macro conditions for LH.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme volume spike (15x), three white soldiers pattern, and RSI 9 overbought create powerful short-term momentum with fear-zone sentiment providing contrarian opportunity for quick swing profits.
debate.key_bear_argument: Stacked macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, FOMC just passed), zero fundamental support, 90-day earnings risk, weak trend strength (ADX 20.26), and price below both 50/200 EMAs make this a high-risk overbought bounce in a deteriorating environment.
